summary: Ring Energy, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a proposed $60 million common stock offering. The filing is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. The offering is underwritten by Mizuho, BofA Securities, and Raymond James, with a 30-day option for underwriters to purchase an additional $9 million. The proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a standard equity offering with no special-situation characteristics.
